Led by physicist Dr William Sansome Tucker, the project followed heavy World War 1 air raids on coastal towns. Faster aircraft, background noise and the arrival of radar made the mirrors obsolete by 1939.

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India batter Tilak Varma was involved in an unusual run-out during the third T20I against West Indies on Sunday after a misunderstanding with Axar Patel cost him his wicket. The incident took place in the 17th over, with Gudakesh Motie bowling to Axar. The Indian all-rounder flicked a low full toss towards deep backward square leg, where Kamil Pooran dived to prevent the ball from reaching the boundary.
title: Bizarre run-out! Tilak Varma’s casual approach leads to unusual dismissal

title: Watch: Moment missile hit Riyadh airport; 13 killed, including Indian national

author: MEGHNA DHULIA
description: In a fervent demonstration, protesters in Delhi sought to reach Jantar Mantar, advocating for the resignation of the Chief Election Commissioner. AISA leader Neha Bora and several participants faced detention as police intervened, triggering a chaotic chase. Bora criticized the cramped conditions of the police bus, emphasizing the ongoing demands for accountability and democratic integrity from those in power.
title: When Delhi cops played catch-up with protesters

author: ABHISHEK MISHRA
title: Saudi Arabia: Fresh Houthi attack on Riyadh airport kills 1; Dammam also targeted

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: Mohammed Shami has been out of favour with the national selectors, but he said he would continue playing wherever he gets an opportunity instead of worrying about his return to the Indian team. The Bengal fast bowler made the remarks after taking four wickets against Delhi in Bengal's opening match of the 2026-27 Ranji Trophy season in Kalyani on Sunday. His figures of 4/30 helped Bengal bowl Delhi out for 240 on the first day.
title: 'Let them do whatever': Shami breaks silence on continued India snubs

title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles towards South Korea; Seoul flags ‘UN violations’

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Grocery shopping transforms into a valuable lesson in financial literacy when parents involve their children in decision-making processes. By allowing kids to make age-appropriate choices, parents help them grasp essential mathematical skills through real-life applications. This collaborative shopping experience not only strengthens the parent-child bond but also equips children with critical money management skills for their future.
title: Why kids who shop with parents learn a hidden life skill

author: GAURAV GUPTA
description: Dilip Vengsarkar has voiced his concerns about the BCCI scheduling an India A tour during the Ranji Trophy season. He argues that this decision diminishes the prestige of the domestic tournament, as domestic players' performances might lose value with top players being diverted to the India A team. Vengsarkar advocates for an earlier acclimatisation trip for the main team instead.
title: Why have India ‘A’ tours during Ranji Trophy, asks Dilip Vengsarkar

author: MEGHNA DHULIA, KOUSHIKI SAHA, G S DHANUSH
description: Journalists covering protests in New Delhi faced detainment by police during their reporting duties. Despite showing valid press credentials, several journalists were forcibly taken into police vans. Among those detained were individuals from established media organizations and independent outlets. The police reportedly acted aggressively towards journalists, leading to injuries and humiliations. This situation raises concerns about media freedom in the capital amidst ongoing protests.
title: ‘Put into buses, vans despite IDs’: Journalists detained again

author: PRATYUSH RAJ
description: Jharkhand opener Shikhar Mohan is making rapid strides in domestic cricket. After scoring 613 runs in his debut Ranji Trophy season, the left-handed opener has started the new campaign with a century against Kerala. With guidance from senior cricketers and a renewed focus on concentration and technique, Mohan is determined to take Jharkhand to greater heights.
title: Shikhar Mohan, another boy from Ranchi, who is making himself count

author: ABHAY
description: A 48-year-old man named Pawan Sharma died following an assault in a Delhi Metro train. The incident occurred due to a dispute over a senior citizen seat during his journey. His mother, Durga Devi, witnessed the altercation between her son and the accused men. Both the alleged assailants, a retired IAS officer and his son, have been arrested by Delhi Metro Police.
title: Man killed in fight over Delhi metro seat; retired IAS officer, son held

author: AMIT KUMAR
description: India captain Shreyas Iyer praised his bowlers for their confident approach and clear plans after the team defeated the West Indies by 14 runs in the third T20I at Holkar Stadium on Sunday. The victory gave India a 2-1 lead in the five-match series. India successfully defended a target of 224, restricting the West Indies to 209/7. Arshdeep Singh took three wickets, while Naman Dhir picked up two scalps to help India stop the visitors from completing another successful chase.
title: 'West Indies, 'West Indies, you can never take them lightly': Shreyas Iyer after India take 2-1 leadyou can never take them lightly': Shreyas Iyer after India take 2-1 lead

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Despite their common misclassification, tomatoes and apples are both fruits that offer distinct nutritional advantages. Apples are rich in fiber, promoting digestive health, while tomatoes are low in calories and boast high vitamin C and lycopene levels, potent antioxidants. Incorporating both into your meals  diversifies your diet and also helps harness their combined health benefits for a healthier lifestyle.
title: Tomato vs apple: Which has more nutrition?

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Delhi experienced heavy rain and thunderstorms on Monday morning, leading to a noticeable change in weather. The India Meteorological Department predicted moderate to heavy rainfall for the next few hours. While cooler temperatures prevail, maximum temperatures are expected to range between 31 and 35 degrees Celsius. The IMD also forecasted partly cloudy skies and no rainfall over the next six days.
title: Delhi-NCR wakes up to heavy rain, thunderstorms

author: SHREEDHAR RATHI
description: Entry and exit at six Delhi Metro stations, including Rajiv Chowk, Central Secretariat and Patel Chowk, will remain closed from 6 am to 4 pm on Monday due to security concerns amid Congress' call for a protest march to the Supreme Court, while interchange facilities will continue to be available at the affected stations, the Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) said.
title: Delhi Metro shuts 6 stations till 4pm amid Congress march; traffic curbs likely

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Kathi rolls, hailing from the vibrant streets of Kolkata, showcase a delectable combination of kebabs enveloped in flaky paratha. In contrast, Mumbai's Frankies feature scrumptious, spiced fillings wrapped in soft roti or paratha, making them uniquely flavorful. Wraps, on the other hand, embody versatility, utilizing various flatbreads to accommodate an array of fillings and sauces.
title: Kathi Kebab Roll vs Frankie vs Wrap: What is the difference?

author: MEGHNA DHULIA
description: Ashutosh Ranka and Saurav Das from Cockroach Janata Party addressed journalists regarding their recent detention. They expressed fears about potential phone hacking after being separated from their devices by police. The activists emphasized their commitment to protesting until Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resigns and accountability is established. Allegations of police misconduct, including the assault of protesters and detaining of student leaders, were also raised.
title: CJP raises ‘phone hacking’ doubts, to continue protest

author: AKSHAY BHAGWAT
description: IIT students report mixed experiences with faculty support, with some professors offering help while others respond insensitively. There is a prevailing culture of academic pressure that impacts students' mental health and performance. Many students feel isolated and overwhelmed in a competitive environment filled with equally accomplished peers. Counselling services exist, but there's a need for more awareness of psychological issues among faculty.
title: IIT students flag uneven faculty support amid academic pressure and mental health concerns
